heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles Bambu PETG HF natively out of the box at up to 250 mm/s thanks to its high-flow formulation capable of 21 mm³/s. Because PETG HF is non-abrasive, the stock stainless steel nozzle and standard direct drive extruder require no hardware upgrades, though keeping the top glass vented during long prints is recommended.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (no release agent required) or Smooth PEI Plate with liquid glue release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 21 mm³/s in the filament profile to prevent extrusion bottlenecks during high-speed moves.
Enable 'Wipe while retracting' set to 2 mm and configure 'Retract amount before wipe' to 70% to eliminate oozing and stringing.
Configure Fan Speed Thresholds with 'Keep fan always on' enabled, setting min cooling to 20% and max to 60% for layer times under 12 seconds.
Set Pressure Advance to approximately 0.038 s (run OrcaSlicer PA Line calibration) to eliminate corner bulging at 250 mm/s print speeds.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine hair-like stringing across travel moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG HF absorbs ambient moisture rapidly, causing steam expansion in the meltzone, or travel speed is insufficient.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry filament in an active dryer at 65°C for 8 hours, enable 'Avoid crossing walls', and increase travel speed to 500 mm/s.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Rough matte surface finish and under-extrusion at top speeds
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Hotend temperature is too low to sustain 21 mm³/s flow, causing nozzle meltzone cooling.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Increase printing temperature from 245°C to 255°C and ensure OrcaSlicer max volumetric speed does not exceed 21 mm³/s.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Excessive adhesion causing PEI sheet damage or part tearing
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: PETG bonds aggressively to smooth PEI coatings via molecular fusion when heated.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Switch to a Bambu Textured PEI plate, or apply Bambu Liquid Glue / PVA glue stick on Smooth PEI as a dedicated sacrificial release barrier.

faq.question: Do I need to leave the P1S door or top glass open when printing Bambu PETG HF?
faq.answer: Ventilating the top glass or cracking the door is recommended during extended prints with high bed temperatures (70°C) to prevent chamber temps exceeding 45°C, which can cause heat creep.

faq.question: Can I print Bambu PETG HF with the stock stainless steel nozzle?
faq.answer: Yes, PETG HF is a non-abrasive polymer without carbon or glass fibers, so the standard 0.4mm stainless steel nozzle will not experience premature wear.

faq.question: How does PETG HF differ from standard Bambu PETG Basic in OrcaSlicer settings?
faq.answer: PETG HF features optimized melt rheology allowing a high volumetric limit of 21 mm³/s versus 13 mm³/s for PETG Basic, unlocking speeds up to 250 mm/s without sacrificing layer adhesion.

faq.question: Is it mandatory to dry Bambu PETG HF straight out of the vacuum packaging?
faq.answer: Yes, PETG HF is hygroscopic and factory packaging often retains residual moisture; drying at 65°C for 6 to 8 hours before printing ensures optimal surface quality and minimal stringing.
